messages:
PagerBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: inference-gateway-prod (eu-west1) 5xx error rate gone above threshold. window=5m, rate=16.8% (>5%). trigger_id=pb-1745009876
IncidentBot: Autopage sent to rotation: @Priya (oncall), escalation policy: infra-tier-1 -> infra-tier-2 in 8m if not acked
Priya (oncall): acked. I'm on it. starting checklist.
Priya (oncall): quick question — did anyone deploy to gateway or routing rules in the last 30m?
Miguel (infra): no infra deploys from my side. but there was a model rollout triggered by ci-cd ~12m ago that changed endpoint routing to v2-quant.
Jordan (sre): grabbing logs + traffic heatmap. can you keep traffic steady, @Lena, any customer calls?
Lena (support): one enterprise customer reported timeouts ~10m ago (CS-3321). they're being notified.
Priya (oncall): running runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gateway-5xx — step 1: confirm error type and scope
Priya (oncall): logs snippet from gateway (tail):
```
2026-03-14T02:11:05Z ERROR downstream: upstream 502 "connection reset by peer" path=/v1/generate model=redwood-v2-quant shard=us-east-1
2026-03-14T02:11:06Z ERROR downstream: upstream 503 "backend overloaded" path=/v1/chat model=redwood-v2-quant
```
Miguel (infra): looks like the v2-quant variant is returning 502/503 from backend workers. rolling back routing to v1 for the prod traffic in eu-west1?
Priya (oncall): suggest we reroute traffic to v1-stable for eu-west1 and spin up extra inference pods in dedicated pool. Jordan, can you issue the routing change?
Jordan (sre): executing routing rollback now: `curl -X POST https://infra-api/redwood/routing -d '{"region":"eu-west1","traffic":{"v1-stable":1.0}}'`
PagerBot: Routing change submitted: request_id=r-1745010050 status=queued
Jordan (sre): applied. verifying...
Priya (oncall): checking metrics: open Grafana dashboard https://grafana.internal/d/AA123/gateway-errors?orgId=1&from=now-15m&to=now
Priya (oncall): error rate dropping: 16.8% -> 8.2% in last 3m
Miguel (infra): provisioning extra workers in eu-west1 (scale +4). kickoff: `kctl scale pool/gateway-eu --replicas=20`
Lena (support): telling CS team: "We saw a transient backend overload affecting eu-west1. We're rolling back a recent model routing change and scaling capacity; will follow up when stable."
IncidentBot: escalation timer paused: acknowledged by Priya (oncall)
Priya (oncall): still watching. any sign of config flaps or OOMs on the v2 pods? Jordan, can you share a pod log (snippets)?
Jordan (sre): pod logs:
```
OOMKilled: process: llm-worker pid=2431 mem=28GB limit=24GB
ERROR worker: failed to allocate kv cache
```
Miguel (infra): that OOM matches v2-quant memory profile — looks like quantized weights still use more transient RAM under heavy concurrency. I suspect we've hit a concurrency bump after rollout.
Priya (oncall): mitigation checklist so far: (1) rollback routing to v1-stable (done), (2) scale pool (in progress), (3) disable autoscaler burst to avoid flapping.
Jordan (sre): disabled burst: `kctl patch hpa gateway-eu --patch '{"spec":{"behavior":{"scaleDown":null}}}'` — done
Priya (oncall): monitoring 2m window. error rate now 2.1% — back below threshold.
Lena (support): CS updated: "Errors returned to baseline. We'll post a post-incident note with timeline & root cause."
Miguel (infra): leaving extra capacity for 30m, will scale down after stable. tagging the deployment owner for the v2-quant rollout: @miguel — can you hold the rollout until we investigate memory profile?
Miguel (infra): yep will pause rollout and open an issue to adjust concurrency and memory flags.
Priya (oncall): creating incident ticket: INC-2026-0457. Summary: 5xx spike in eu-west1 caused by v2-quant worker OOM under concurrency after rollout. Mitigation: rollback routing + scale up.
Priya (oncall): next steps: postmortem to include reproducer (load test with kv cache stress), quantization memory audit, and guardrails for routing rollouts.
Jordan (sre): adding timeline to ticket and attaching logs.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-0457 created and linked to PagerBot alert pb-1745009876
Priya (oncall): closing the active page in 10m unless it reappears. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Lena (support): I'll prepare customer comms draft for the affected tenant.
PagerBot: ALERT cleared: inference-gateway-prod (eu-west1) error rate back under threshold. cleared_at=1745013200
Priya (oncall): resolved. last check: 0.9% error rate; follow-ups assigned.
Lena (support): marking CS ticket as 'monitoring' — will update customers with root cause when postmortem ready.
Jordan (sre): leaving debug logs in /var/logs/incidents/1745009876.log and will scrub PII then attach to the incident.
Miguel (infra): created follow-up issue: https://redwood.internal/issue/INFRA-7782 — owner: miguel — will include memory tuning and stricter canary rules.
Priya (oncall): handoff to oncall rotation: @Miguel will watch for 1h, escalation reopened if rate >5% again.
Priya (oncall): final note: no broader customer impact beyond the one reported tenant; all services nominal. closing thread.
